data.title: FAQ — SaaSTEMLY
data.excerpt: Answers to common questions about working with SaaSTEMLY — pricing, process, support, and more.

content.html:
FAQ

Questions.

Everything you need to know about working with us. If something is missing, ask us directly — we answer within one working day.

What types of software do you build?

Custom web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, AI-powered features, and e-commerce systems. We work with React, Next.js, Vue, Node.js, Python, and modern cloud platforms.

How long does a typical project take?

Simple apps take 2–4 weeks. Complex platforms take 3–6 months. We scope every project with a clear timeline before work begins.

Do you provide ongoing support after launch?

Yes. We offer maintenance packages that include bug fixes, security updates, performance tuning, and feature additions — with service-level agreements to match your needs.

What does your development process look like?

We work in agile sprints with regular check-ins. The process: discovery, design, build, test, deploy, and iterate. You see progress every week, not just at the end.

Can you integrate with our existing systems?

Yes. We regularly work with existing codebases, databases, APIs, and third-party services — ensuring seamless integration without disrupting what already works.

How does pricing work?

We offer fixed-price projects, hourly time-and-materials, and monthly retainers. Reach out for a free consultation and we will provide a detailed quote based on your scope.

How do we get started?

Reach out through our contact page or email contact@saastemly.com. We will schedule a free consultation to discuss your requirements, then provide a clear proposal with scope, timeline, and pricing.

How do you handle security and data protection?

Security is built into every project from day one. We follow secure coding standards, conduct regular audits, encrypt data at rest and in transit, and comply with GDPR and other relevant regulations.

Still need more help?

Tell us what you are working on — we will respond within 24 hours.

Contact us
